evidence.title: AI Juggler README
evidence.locator: Why, Download, Quick start, What works today, Supported tools, What AI Juggler reads, writes and sends, Permissions, FAQ, Roadmap
evidence.finding: macOS 14+ app listing sessions across the Claude app, Claude Code, Codex, Codex app and Cursor by app and account; starts sessions with real CLIs; usage and cost per session, account and project; monthly caps that warn; switching a conversation between accounts or tools (beta); Fleet across Macs (beta); OpenCode, Kimi Code and Grok Build beta; Windows and Linux planned; MIT.

evidence.title: AI Juggler CHANGELOG
evidence.finding: Header Home, Projects, Pools, Tasks, Accounts, Usage, History arrived in 0.3; Tasks shows every pool's epics, stories and tasks filtered by project and pool.

evidence.title: Guide: Pools
evidence.locator: lines 1-180 (making a pool, roles, who may message whom, team tools)
evidence.finding: A pool is a team of sessions with a lead, members and a reviewer that share messages, notes and tasks through AI Juggler's connector; message rules include members ask you first; the person makes pools and approves what matters.

evidence.title: Guide: Pools, Tasks section
evidence.locator: Tasks and What you can do on a task
evidence.finding: Agents write and run tasks with ids like aj-7f3c, statuses Ready, In progress, In review, Blocked, To do, Done; epics and stories; waits-on links block until done; only one session can take a task; person can approve, send back, free, cancel or start a session for a task; no New task button.

evidence.title: juggler-core tasks.rs
evidence.finding: Task kinds epic, story and task with parent, short id, title, body, acceptance criteria, priority, status, assignee and optional external issue link; links blocks, relates to, duplicates; readiness computed from open blockers.

evidence.title: agentbridge task_tools.rs
evidence.locator: tool definitions tasks_list, task_get, task_create, task_claim, task_update, task_assign
evidence.finding: Agents list, read, create, claim, update and assign pool tasks through MCP tools.

evidence.title: agentbridge mcp.rs
evidence.locator: tool definitions whoami, pool_roster, set_status, send_message, read_inbox, ack, share_doc, read_doc, pool_cards
evidence.finding: Team tools let agents see the roster, set status, send and read messages, acknowledge and share or read notes.

evidence.title: agentbridge cli.rs
evidence.finding: The bridge is an MCP server (--mcp) and a plain command line for tools without MCP; its key comes only from the environment.

evidence.title: Guide: Usage and limits
evidence.finding: Tokens and cost per session, app, account and project from the tools' records at providers' published list prices, labelled as estimates; Export CSV; monthly caps warn at 80% and 100% and never stop work.

evidence.title: Guide: Sessions and the terminal
evidence.locator: Your sessions, Searching what was said
evidence.finding: Session list groups open sessions by app; History holds every ended session, searchable by words; index for outside sessions is opt-in.

evidence.title: Guide: Fleet
evidence.finding: Other Macs in one window: their sessions and usage, starting a session on one, carrying a conversation; paired Macs talk directly over the local network with no relay.

evidence.title: Guide: Keep work going
evidence.finding: Off by default; a crashed session is started again and each restart is noted; the Mac can be kept awake while sessions work.

evidence.title: Guide: Continue in another app
evidence.finding: Switching moves a conversation's files between accounts of one tool and resumes, or tells the other tool the story so far between Claude Code and Codex; not lossless and shown before confirming.

evidence.title: Guide: What AI Juggler touches
evidence.finding: Caches stay local; agents write tasks and the app writes none; the Figurehead account is optional; Fleet connects only paired Macs directly and encrypted.

evidence.title: Usage statistics
evidence.finding: Usage statistics are Off by default, Keep on this computer, or Share weekly; chosen in onboarding with nothing preselected; switching Off deletes local data.

evidence.title: Guide: The Floor
evidence.finding: The Floor shows all apps, sessions and subagents as an office seen from above, with busy, waiting, stuck and crashing states; macOS now.

evidence.title: AI Juggler roadmap
evidence.finding: 0.5 adds more tools, pools across Macs and handing work to a colleague; 0.6 and 0.7 bring Windows and Linux; 1.0 after the Windows release.

evidence.title: juggler-app Cargo.toml
evidence.finding: Desktop app is built on Tauri 2.12.4 with a tray icon.

evidence.title: AI Juggler LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT License, copyright Faruk Brbovic and AI Juggler contributors; names and logos are trademarks outside the licence (TRADEMARKS.md).

evidence.title: AI Juggler product page
evidence.finding: Free, open source, macOS; works beside the Claude app, Claude Code, Codex app, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Grok Build, Kimi Code and Cursor; usage stats off unless turned on; Beta 0.4.0 download named; Sign in link.

evidence.title: AI Juggler issues and discussions
evidence.finding: Public issues and Discussions for ideas and support; no dated announcements beyond the roadmap.

evidence.title: Bounded search: isolation
evidence.locator: grep -rliE "git worktree add|docker|container|sandbox" crates (*.rs) and docs/guide; worktrees appear only as read from Claude Squad and Vibe Kanban
evidence.finding: AI Juggler creates no worktrees, containers or sandboxes; sessions run where the user's tools run.

evidence.title: Bounded search: git shipping
evidence.locator: grep -rliE "gh pr create|git push|pull request" crates (*.rs) and docs/guide
evidence.finding: No commit, push, pull request or merge actions; tasks can link an issue and look up its state.

evidence.title: Bounded search: teams and SSO
evidence.finding: No SSO, organisations or shared workspaces; handing work to a colleague is a 0.5 roadmap item.

evidence.title: Bounded search: schedules and webhooks
evidence.finding: No user schedules, recurring tasks or webhooks; background work is update checks and the daily npm version check.

evidence.title: AI Juggler recovery-tasks
evidence.locator: may_plan/may_change 540-610; storage/tasks.rs migration and update; agentbridge/task_tools.rs task_update; app/features/tasks/issues.rs; ui/src/pages/tasks/PoolTasks.tsx and TaskView.tsx
evidence.finding: Leads plan all kinds and edit any task; others plan tasks and edit their own unheld or held tasks. Kind is immutable in update; no archive operation. Tasks and append-only events persist in SQLite; event triggers reject changes/deletes. GitHub issue/PR title and state are looked up through gh with a 10-second timeout; Linear is a labelled link. No external writes/sync. Review queue, plan grouping, reviewer verdicts and send-back notes exist, with responsive stacked detail below the lg breakpoint; no exact-revision merge gate.

evidence.title: AI Juggler recovery-notes
evidence.locator: insert_doc/docs/doc 1236-1310, event migration; agentbridge/mcp.rs tools; guide/pools.md shared notes and approvals
evidence.finding: Shared docs have immutable ids, sha256, author, pool and creation time; sharing inserts another record, not an in-place note edit. No note-delete or freshness-expiry operation in the bridge/storage inventory. Notes and events persist locally. Pool permissions offer Allow once/Always allow and Take back from the next request. Pause/Stop controls messaging, not OS process suspension.

evidence.title: AI Juggler recovery-runtime
evidence.locator: module contract and quit flow; guide/keep-work-going.md; guide/sessions-and-the-terminal.md; supervisor/supervisor.rs process lifecycle
evidence.finding: Closing the window hides it and keeps sessions running. Quitting ends app-owned terminal sessions; external desktop and re-adopted sessions can continue. Crash restart is opt-in, maximum three in ten minutes, resumes only when conversation identity is known, otherwise fresh. No generic exactly-once replay ledger for arbitrary commands; task claims and Fleet requests have narrower deduplication. No task run budget or compute scheduler in supervisor/bridge/task inventory; messaging hop limits and remote-operation deadlines are distinct.

evidence.title: AI Juggler recovery-ai
evidence.locator: whole guide; app/features/ai model selection/download implementation
evidence.finding: Public opt-in beta local AI jobs write turn reviews and answer Chat questions using Apple on-device models or an explicitly downloaded Qwen3 1.7B model. These are helper models, not extra coding harnesses.

evidence.title: AI Juggler recovery-data
evidence.locator: How a report works; guide/trust.md reads/writes/sends; guide/switching.md Save a handover and import
evidence.finding: Optional anonymous weekly raw telemetry reports persist for 35 days then aggregates; sent reports cannot be located for individual deletion. Off deletes local stats. Fleet can move conversations explicitly. Pasted service keys use macOS Keychain; Kimi local server token is a stated exception. Handover files can be saved/imported. Account/backup provider policy remains separate.

evidence.title: AI Juggler recovery-scope
evidence.locator: whole guide; guide/pools.md 330-440; app features inventory searched for SSO, RBAC, schedule, webhook, git push, pr create, worktree add, container; ui/src/pages/tasks/TaskView.tsx
evidence.finding: Fleet connects paired Macs directly, including via Tailscale/WireGuard. View versus control, optional ask-each-time and pair revocation are available. These do not establish named-person shared workspaces or organisation roles. Pool task review is available; no product-owned git shipping, security sandbox, code-index service, spec-drift engine or external work scheduler in the inspected modules.

evidence.title: AI Juggler usage-stats and crash-report consent gates at commit 030f839
evidence.locator: crates/juggler-app/src/usage_stats.rs lines 1-6 and 78-94 (stored choice off when unset; recorder starts only unless off); crates/juggler-app/src/crash.rs lines 125-152 (setting never when unset; DO_NOT_TRACK forces never); crates/juggler-app/src/crash_send.rs line 43; crates/juggler-app/src/updates.rs lines 1-8 and 59-62 (update feed on GitHub releases)
evidence.finding: The usage-statistics choice is off when unset, and only Share mode sends weekly reports; switching off deletes local stats. The crash-report setting is never when unset, and DO_NOT_TRACK forces never. Update checks read GitHub releases, and the daily signed configuration download carries no user data.

evidence.title: AI Juggler Settings › Privacy pane at commit 030f839
evidence.locator: ui/src/screens/settings/PrivacyPane.tsx lines 89-100 (Usage statistics, crash reports and search section: off until you choose); ui/src/components/UsageStatsChooser.tsx (Off, Keep on this computer, Share weekly)
evidence.finding: Settings › Privacy has a section for usage statistics and crash reports, which are off until the user chooses. The chooser offers Off, Keep stats on this computer only, and Share weekly usage stats.
